[[File:Duckling (non-interactive) chathead.png|left|70px]]
'''Ducklings''' are baby [[ducks]] found in bodies of water where other ducks can be found. They usually follow adult ducks around.

Ducklings can also be fed [[breadcrumbs]], though there is no purpose to this.

==Trivia==
* When [[Saradomin]] built his camp over the pond as part of the [[Battle of Lumbridge]], the attackable ducklings were removed from the game. On the [[6 March]] [[2017]] update, the crater was reverted to something like its original state and the ducklings returned.
*Previously, the duck they were following would occasionally say "Quack?" and the ducklings would reply with "Cheep Cheep!" or "Eep!". If the duck that the ducklings were following was killed, the ducklings would say, "Eek!".
